_owner: R4 (outpost recovery crews, spec-rehydrate.md 3.3). Keys: RECOVERY_LINE_* in voidcrew/_DEFINES/outpost_recovery.dm, plus the ambient contexts (idle, talk, work, chat, reply, attacked, violence, leave) and conversations. Placeholders: {name}, {other}, {place}.

call: Desk to all units. The concourse is quiet. Cleaning crew on their way.
All units, stand easy. The crew is coming down to clear up.
Desk to beat. Quiet now. Sending the cleaners and the morgue crew.
first_body: Poor soul. Somebody tell the desk.
officer_body: That's one of the officers. Radio the desk.
Oh no. It's Port Authority. Tell the desk.
One of theirs. Careful with this one.
tray: One in the morgue. Tray's shut.
Morgue has one more. Tray's closed.
Settled in the morgue. Somebody will come asking.
lift: Calling the lift. Hold the door.
Lift coming down. Mind your fingers.
mess: I only did this floor on Tuesday.
That is not coming out with soap.
chat: Did you see the state of the diner?
Somebody left a bottle in the planter again.

conversations.opener: Do you ever get the smell out of your gloves?
What's the worst one you've seen?

call: Desk to all. Concourse secure. Cleanup crew inbound.
All units, hold position. Sending the crew.
Concourse quiet. Cleanup is on the way.
officer_body: Depot officer down. Radio it in.
One of ours. Get a bag.
mess: Who signs off on this much blood?
Overtime for this. I mean it.
chat: Union's going to hear about this.

conversations.opener: Is this overtime or isn't it?
How long till the next freighter?

call: Desk to all. It's quiet. Send in the sweepers.
All wardens, stand down. The crew's coming for the mess.
Concourse is yours again. Cleanup's on the way.
first_body: Bag. Now. Before it gets worse.
officer_body: That's a warden. Be nice to this one.
tray: One in the morgue. It's quiet in there.
lift: Lift. I haven't got all day.
mess: Somebody always bleeds on the nice floor.
I don't get paid enough for this.
mind_floor: Wet floor. Fall on your own time.
Careful. It's wet. I'm not carrying you.
idle: Don't ask what's in the bag.
talk: Don't look at me. I just clean.

conversations.opener: Which one's worse, the blood or the paperwork?
You think they pay hazard rates for this?
